title: 第9章  佳孟关
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
这时候，天边飞来一道红色流光，宋璇旁边的苏辞眼睛一亮：
“咦？来了。”
旁边几人都回头了，看到那红光落在甲板上，变成白衣紫眸的少女后，宋璇立即就大声地道：
“谢莲心，你到底几个意思啊，来得这么迟？”
“我好像没有迟到吧，巳时三刻，我很准时啊。你们来早了而已。”谢莲心道。
谢莲心往旁边的那座山峰一指，山峰上有日晷，巨大的日晷之上显示的时间正好是巳时三刻。谢莲心确实没有迟到，她就是踩点来的，而其他人都是早早地到了，所以显得她迟了。
“你、你还顶嘴。”宋璇怒道。
谢莲心说：“我实话实说，我分明一刻都没耽误，给我扣上故意延误时辰的罪名，我可不认。凭什么？”
“提前来这里，这不是应该的吗？”宋璇就是厌恶谢莲心这肆无忌惮的样子，天才，天才了不起吗？
谢莲心翻了个白眼，懒得搭理宋璇。
宋璇气得要飙的时候，一股渡劫期的威压笼罩整艘战船，众人心神一颤，抬头就看到了战船最高处站着的青年。
戴着紫色发冠的青年，面容俊美，神情严肃，他是这次去佳孟关的领队，清月峰大师兄严欢。
严欢道：“好了，诸位师弟师妹，人到齐了，就出发吧。”
他说完战船就启动了，甲板上的众人有些留在了这战船之上看风景，有些朝着船舱走去，拿着手中的牌子，进入各自的房间里面打坐修炼。
谢莲心来得晚了，发房间牌号的时候她不在，她正要开口问严欢，高处的严欢就将一物朝着她扔来，谢莲心抬手一接，是一块玉牌，写着前面标着“五”，后面标着个“十六”字。
五层，十六号房间。
谢莲心拿着玉牌飞到第五层甲板上，又朝着船舱走去。
————
一个月后。
战船穿透稀薄的云雾，谢莲心站在甲板上凭栏望去，视野骤然被那道横亘于天地间的巨影所占据。

佳孟关，宏伟粗犷。
关城依着天然山脉而建，墙体是厚重的青黑色玄青石，古老的城墙在天光下泛着冷硬的金属光泽，城墙表面刻满庞大的阵法纹路，流淌着稳定的淡金色灵光。
要塞的高墙沿着地势起伏蜿蜒，宛如一条沉睡的巨龙脊背，一眼望不到尽头。墙顶旌旗招展，巡弋修士的遁光规律而有序。
此处的两界壁垒相对稳定，混沌气息被大阵梳理，天空呈现一种深邃而平静的、宛如墨玉般的暗蓝色，只在靠近魔界一侧，才有些不祥的暗紫色漩涡缓缓转动，偶尔能看到空间裂缝一闪而过，开裂又消失。
对于谢莲心而言，这佳孟关早已经没有什么稀奇的，宋璇等化神期或是元婴期、金丹期弟子们也早就来过要塞，并不惊讶。
柳如烟和其他筑基期弟子是第一次来到界面要塞，一个个眼中都充满了震惊，光是这边界的肃杀气息，就让他们心惊胆战了。
但实际上，佳孟关不是危险的要塞，它算是诸多要塞中最安全的几个之一了，要不然也不会让低阶的弟子来这里历练了。
战船朝着关城内一片开阔的泊台平稳降下，众人一个个地从船上下来。
泊台上已有修士等候，为首的一人是个穿着白衣披着青袍的渡劫期男修，这男修是韩素雪的徒弟，名为杜信。杜信身后跟着两个大乘期，都是玄天宗之人，这要塞都是玄天宗弟子。
杜信是佳孟关总领，让一个渡劫期做总领，也能看得出此关并非险要关卡，不然定有仙人镇守。
若是真正的危险要塞，那仙人级的高手，至少有十名以上。
“严师兄。”杜信跟严欢寒暄了几句之后，这才看向了来历练的众弟子们。
杜信的视线落在柳如烟身上，柳如烟冲着他温柔地一笑：“杜师兄。”
作为韩素雪的弟子，杜信认识柳如烟一点都不稀奇。
“烟儿师妹，你居然也来了。我还以为玉阳师伯至少会让你修炼到筑基后期才来这里。”杜信笑着说。
“我跟师姐一起来的。”柳如烟轻声细语地道，她望着杜信面颊微红，好像涂抹了胭脂一般，压倒桃花。
杜信看着这样的柳如烟心中一荡，他早就喜欢这位柳师妹了，见柳如烟面对自己脸红，还道柳如烟对他有意呢。
宋璇在旁边看着这一幕，心中不爽。
这杜师兄老盯着烟儿师妹做什么？
不知道非礼勿视吗？

杜信看了柳如烟许久，才看向了谢莲心，一看到谢莲心他的目光就冷了。杜信实际上也就见过谢莲心两次而已，他对谢莲心的敌意源自于他师父，也源自于柳如烟。
他可没少听说谢莲心欺负烟儿师妹。
“杜师兄这么看我做什么？我脸上有花？”谢莲心问。
“没想到宗主师伯会让你来这里，来这里可是要吃苦的，谢师妹金尊玉贵，娇生惯养，也不知道能不能在这里待得下去？听说师妹只待半年，果然有宗主师伯撑腰，就是不同。”杜信笑道。
其他的弟子从筑基到元婴，加起来必须要在要塞历练五年半，这时间其实也不长，还是分开的。所以不管是仙二代还是千辛万苦才进入玄天宗的弟子，都不会反对这样的历练。
整个玄天宗，从筑基期到元婴后期，都没来过要塞的，只有谢莲心。虽然大家心知肚明是为什么，也总归有人不满的。
以前就算了，她年纪太小了，现在也十四了，待半年就可以走了，这不公平嘛。
“杜师兄说得是呢，早知道杜师兄对我这么不满，我四岁的时候，爬也爬到边塞来了。”谢莲心笑着说。
立即有人笑出声来。
是杜信身后一个大乘后期的女弟子，那女弟子身段高挑，男装打扮。谢莲心知道她的名字，她叫霍嫣，白玉峰峰主的女儿。
杜信瞪了霍嫣一眼，霍嫣不以为意。
杜信脸色有点难看，他自己也知道自己是鸡蛋里面挑骨头。
谢莲心元婴后期才来边塞历练，是她太变态了。她的天赋太恐怖了，正常人修炼到筑基期都是二十几岁，三十几岁，十五岁以前筑基的个个是天才，她四岁就筑基了。
谁会把四岁奶娃娃放边塞历练啊？
“好了杜师兄，先让师弟师妹们休息一下吧。”严欢出言道。
content_en:
At this time, a stream of red light flew from the sky, and Su Ci's eyes lit up next to Song Xuan:
"Huh? Here we come."
Several people nearby turned around. When they saw the red light falling on the deck and turning into a girl with white clothes and purple eyes, Song Xuan immediately said loudly:
"Xie Lianxin, what do you mean by coming so late?"
"It seems I'm not late. It's already three o'clock. I'm on time. You guys are just early." Xie Lian thought to herself.
Xie Lianxin pointed to the mountain peak next to her. There was a sundial on the mountain peak. The time displayed on the huge sundial was exactly three o'clock. Xie Lianxin was indeed not late, she just arrived at the right time, while everyone else arrived early, so it seemed that she was late.
"You, you still talk back." Song Xuan said angrily.
Xie Lianxin said: "I tell the truth. I clearly didn't delay a moment. If you accuse me of deliberately delaying time, I don't admit it. Why?"
"Isn't it right to come here early?" Song Xuan just hates Xie Lianxin's unscrupulous look. Genius, isn't genius amazing?
Xie Lianxin rolled her eyes and was too lazy to talk to Song Xuan.
When Song Xuan was so angry that a pressure from the tribulation period enveloped the entire warship. Everyone's hearts trembled. They looked up and saw the young man standing at the highest point of the warship.
The young man wearing a purple hair crown has a handsome face and a serious expression. He is the leader of the team going to Jiameng Pass this time, Qingyue Peak Senior Brother Yan Huan.
Yan Huan said: "Okay, junior brothers and sisters, when everyone is here, let's set off."
After he finished speaking, the warship started. Some of the people on the deck stayed on the warship to watch the scenery, while others walked towards the cabin, holding the signs in their hands, and entered their respective rooms to meditate and practice.
Xie Lianxin came late and was not there when the room numbers were distributed. She was about to ask Yan Huan when Yan Huan from above threw something towards her.
Fifth floor, room 16.
Xie Lianxin took the jade token and flew to the fifth deck, then walked towards the cabin.
————
One month later.
The warship penetrated the thin clouds and mist. Xie Lianxin stood on the deck and leaned on the railing to look. Her vision was suddenly occupied by the giant shadow that stretched between the sky and the earth.
Jiameng Pass is magnificent and rough.
Guancheng was built against the natural mountains. The walls were made of thick black bluestone. The ancient city wall glowed with a cold metallic luster under the sky. The surface of the city wall was engraved with huge formation patterns and flowed with a stable light golden aura.
The high walls of the fortress undulate along the terrain, like the back of a sleeping dragon, with no end in sight. Flags were fluttering on the top of the wall, and the patrolling monks' escapes were regular and orderly.
The barriers between the two realms here are relatively stable, and the chaotic atmosphere is sorted out by a large array. The sky shows a deep and calm dark blue like ink jade. Only on the side close to the demon world, some ominous dark purple vortices slowly rotate. Occasionally, space cracks can be seen flashing past, cracking and then disappearing.
For Xie Lianxin, there is nothing strange about Jiameng Pass. Song Xuan and other disciples of the Divine Transformation Stage, Nascent Soul Stage, and Golden Core Stage have also been to the fortress a long time ago, so they are not surprised.
Liu Ruyan and other foundation-building disciples came to the Interface Fortress for the first time, and their eyes were filled with shock. Just the chilling aura of this border made them tremble with fear.
But in fact, Jiameng Pass is not a dangerous fortress. It is one of the safest among many fortresses. Otherwise, low-level disciples would not be allowed to come here to practice.
The warship lowered smoothly towards the open berth in Guancheng, and everyone got off the ship one by one.
There are monks waiting on the platform. The leader is a male cultivator who is in the tribulation stage wearing white clothes and a green robe. This male cultivator is Han Suxue's disciple, named Du Xin. Du Xin was followed by two Mahayana disciples, both of whom were from the Xuantian Sect, and were both disciples of the Xuantian Sect in this fortress.
Du Xin is Jiameng PassCommander-in-Chief, let someone who is in the Tribulation Stage be the Commander-in-Chief. You can also see that this level is not a dangerous level, otherwise there will be immortals guarding it.
If it were a truly dangerous fortress, there would be at least ten immortal-level masters.
"Senior Brother Yan." After Du Xin exchanged a few words with Yan Huan, he looked at the disciples who had come to practice.
Du Xin's eyes fell on Liu Ruyan, and Liu Ruyan smiled gently at him: "Senior Brother Du."
As a disciple of Han Suxue, it was not surprising that Du Xin knew Liu Ruyan.
"Junior sister Yan'er, you're actually here. I thought that Uncle Yuyang would at least let you practice until the late stage of foundation building before coming here." Du Xin said with a smile.
"I came here with senior sister." Liu Ruyan whispered softly. She looked at Du Xin's cheeks which were slightly red, as if they were smeared with rouge, overpowering the peach blossoms.
Du Xin's heart trembled when he saw Liu Ruyan like this. He had already liked this junior sister Liu. Seeing Liu Ruyan blushing in front of him, he said that Liu Ruyan was interested in him.
Song Xuan watched this scene from the side, feeling unhappy.
Why is Senior Brother Du always staring at Junior Sister Yan'er?
Don’t you know, don’t look at anything inappropriate?
Du Xin looked at Liu Ruyan for a long time before looking at Xie Lianxin. His eyes turned cold when he saw Xie Lianxin. Du Xin had actually only met Xie Lianxin twice. His hostility towards Xie Lianxin originated from his master and Liu Ruyan.
He had often heard that Xie Lianxin bullied Junior Sister Yan'er.
"Senior Brother Du, why do you look at me like this? Is there something wrong with my face?" Xie Lianxin asked.
"I didn't expect that the sect master and uncle would let you come here. It's going to be hard to come here. Junior sister Xie is a noble and pampered child. I don't know if I can stay here. I heard that junior sister will only stay for half a year. As expected, it is different with the support of the sect master and uncle." Du Xin said with a smile.
From Foundation Establishment to Nascent Soul, the other disciples have to practice in the fortress for a total of five and a half years. This time is actually not long, and they are still separated. Therefore, no matter whether they are second-generation immortals or disciples who have gone through a lot of hard work to enter the Xuantian Sect, they will not object to such experience.
From the entire Xuantian Sect, from the foundation building stage to the late Nascent Soul stage, no one has ever been to the fortress, only Xie Lianxin. Although everyone knows why, there are always some people who are dissatisfied.
Forget it before, she was too young, and now she is fourteen. She can leave after half a year. This is not fair.
"Senior Brother Du is right. If I had known that Senior Brother Du was so dissatisfied with me, I would have crawled to the border fortress when I was four years old." Xie Lianxin said with a smile.
Someone laughed immediately.
It was a female disciple from the late Mahayana period behind Du Xin. The female disciple was tall and dressed in men's clothing. Xie Lianxin knew her name. Her name was Huo Yan, the daughter of the master of Baiyu Peak.
Du Xin glared at Huo Yan, but Huo Yan didn't take it seriously.
Du Xin's face was a bit ugly, and he knew that he was being picky.
Xie Lianxin Yuanying came to the frontier for training at a later stage, because she was too perverted. Her talent is so terrifying. Normal people would be in their twenties or thirties when they reach the foundation building stage. Everyone who builds the foundation before the age of fifteen is a genius. She established the foundation at the age of four.
Who would put a four-year-old baby in a frontier for training?
"Okay, Senior Brother Du, let the junior brothers and sisters take a rest first." Yan Huan said.
